newsitem.title: USA: Salomon same-store sales index up 4.6 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: Salomon same-store sales index up 4.6 pct in June.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said its Same-Store Sales Growth Index rose 4.6 percent in June compared to a 4.4 percent rise in the same month a year ago and a 2.4 percent gain in May.
Salomon cited more seasonable weather during the latter part of the month.
"An improving sales trend in June, combined with adjustments in purchase levels, have basically realigned inventories and sales for the majority of the major broadline retailers," it stated.

Based on strong inventory and expense controls, Salomon expects earnings of retailers to outpace the average earnings of the S&P 500 companies beginning in the second quarter, or at the latest the third quarter of this year.
